results.notes: Comprehensive curated collection of 2025 academic research papers (sections 0.1-0.12) plus 2024 and earlier foundational work. Focus areas: covariance estimation, factor models, active management, optimization, hierarchical methods. Explicitly prioritizes 2025 papers first. No code references - this is pure research literature review. Highly valuable for staying current with state-of-the-art methods. Well-organized with clear implementation priorities (Phase 1-3). References papers like RL-BHRP, Cost-aware Portfolios, Attention-Enhanced RL that inform ARBS development.

Detailed research on covariance estimation for highly correlated assets (90%+ correlation typical in STIR futures). Evaluates three methods: ERSE (2025, best but no code), MTP2 (2019, best with code available), and Constant Correlation (2004, already in ARBS). Includes empirical evidence, implementation sketches, and clear recommendations. Status updated 2025-11-11. All code references verified to exist. Recommends implementing MTP2 as next enhancement (3-5 day effort). Critical finding: Ledoit-Wolf limited benefit at ρ>0.90, MTP2 shows 10-15% risk reduction.

results.notes: Core framework documentation for ARBS. Comprehensive guide to Grinold-Kahn portfolio management framework implementation. Documents architecture with clear phase completion status (Phases 1-4 complete as of 2025-11-11, 582 tests passing). Includes detailed signal types, risk models, optimization, and equity extension. Section 8 added 2025-11-11 covers equity-specific implementation extending to 500-stock portfolios. Architecture status accurately reflects codebase. Contains practical code examples, formulas, and success criteria. Critical document linking theory to implementation.

Comprehensive analysis of current ARBS covariance implementation dated 2025-11-11. Documents 6 implemented estimators, test coverage (582 tests), factory integration, and YAML examples. Default method: Ledoit-Wolf with constant correlation. Identifies three critical gaps: (1) LW uses known-mean formula (should be LW_u), (2) Factory doesn't expose all estimators, (3) No empirical validation on real futures data. Provides detailed recommendations with priorities. All code references verified. Very accurate snapshot of implementation status. Serves as both documentation and improvement roadmap.
